calculator_engine: function hra(basic,hraRcvd,rent,isMetro){const pct=isMetro?0.50:0.40;const a=hraRcvd;const b=basic*pct;const c=Math.max(0,rent-basic*0.10);const exemption=Math.min(a,b,c);return{exemption,taxableHRA:hraRcvd-exemption};}
